name: Tidemark — Fintech
description: A poster-loud fintech landing page for Tidemark, business banking for startups: oxblood, cream, pink and coral, heavy extended caps, square edges and warm moody photography — a photo hero with the account form, a metal card and a live balance strip over the name set edge to edge, a colour-block product grid with working mini-UIs, a treasury yield calculator and chart, security, customer stories, monthly/yearly pricing, an FAQ and a disclosures footer.
designedFor: Fintech, banking, payments and treasury products
B2B SaaS that sells to finance teams and founders
Pages that need a calculator, a chart and honest disclosures beside the marketing
Seeing a count-up, a pointer-driven card and an interactive chart built as editor-controllable components
